Title: Sword of the Righteous aggravated damage duration.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Effects from a combat card lasts per default the round the card is played.

What about Sword of the Righteous' [val] effect.
"As above" doesn't imply that the [val] effect has the same duration.

Is it correct to assume that the [val] effect last for the current round?

Name: Sword of the Righteous
[BL:C1, LoB:C, HttB:PSal3]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Valeren/Animalism
Only usable before range is determined.
[ani] Choose one of this vampire's melee weapons. For the remainder of combat, this vampire inflicts +1 damage each strike with that weapon. A vampire can play only one Sword of the Righteous each combat.
[val] As [ani] above, and the damage this vampire inflicts with the weapon is aggravated.
[VAL] As [val] above, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage this round.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Dorrinal
Messages.Body:
Replace "As [val] above" with the actual text and you get:
>
> [VAL] As [ani] above, and the damage this vampire inflicts with the weapon is aggravated, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage this round.
>
Replace "As [ani] above" with the actual text of [ani] and you get:
>
> [VAL] Choose one of this vampire's melee weapons. For the remainder of combat, this vampire inflicts +1 damage each strike with that weapon. A vampire can play only one Sword of the Righteous each combat, and the damage this vampire inflicts with the weapon is aggravated, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage this round.
>
This is confusing because "A vampire can only play one Sword of the Righteous each combat" is in the way. How it should read:

> [VAL] Choose one of this vampire's melee weapons. For the remainder of combat, this vampire inflicts +1 damage each strike with that weapon, and the damage this vampire inflicts with the weapon is aggravated, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage this round. A vampire can play only one Sword of the Righteous each combat.
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I disagree with you because all combat effects last, by default, only for the current round.
Having
[x] Gain Y this combat.
[y] As above, and gain Z.

doesn't mean Z lasts for the combat.

For instance, does it mean then that Mythic Form's maneuver is valid for the whole combat?

Name: Mythic Form
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 3 blood
Discipline: Protean
[pro] Play before range is determined on the first round. For the remainder of this combat, this vampire gets +1 strength and can prevent 1 non-aggravated damage each round. A vampire can play only one Mythic Form each combat.
[PRO] As above, but with an optional maneuver, and this vampire can inflict 2R aggravated damage as a strike once each round this combat.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
